title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/oscore_ctx.c:405 TOCTOU race in oscore_ctx_create_with_eui64: after oscore_ctx_create returns (which unlocks mutex), the function re-locks at line 394 and modifies ctx without verifying it has not been recycled.
